decision: Reuse plant eligibility with a new typed sprite representation
why: Preserve old plant behaviour while isolating metre sizes and atlas variants

decision: Use an IconLayer subclass and an independently generated 72 KB atlas
why: Reuse texture lifecycle and projection; a custom mesh adds needless renderer ownership

decision: Run Jest directly after documented wrapper selected no tests
why: pnpm test -- --runInBand forwarded an extra separator as a filename filter

decision: Leave existing missing ice registry row unchanged
why: It predates this task; acceptance instruction says not to repair unrelated failures

decision: Compute icon pixel size inside the wind hook
why: Shader hooks are separate functions and cannot reference main-local sizePixels; first real scene caught shader failure

decision: Use Domodossola valley coordinates for the Alps views
why: First high alpine camera was dominated by near terrain; low valley lets the existing camera show forest

decision: Move wind, fade and tint from DECKGL hooks to vs:#main-end with own varyings
why: Hook functions are emitted before IconLayer's attributes and varyings (vColor, instanceSizes), so the shader failed to link and no tree ever drew

decision: Redraw the atlas: crowns of lit leaf clusters on ellipsoid lumps, back to front over a dark interior
why: First atlas clipped crowns at cell edges and drew broadleaf as hollow umbrellas; task bar is realism

decision: Per-tile LOD from projected pixels of a 20 m tree at the tile's nearest point, not tile zoom
why: Probe showed every close-up tile is z13 (maxZoom clamp), so tile zoom carried no distance; Alps z13 drew 328k trees at 10-14 fps
result: Alps z13 275k trees, fps within noise of flag off

decision: Keep the 18,000 candidates/tile cap; document rainforest as scattered crowns
why: Off fps is already under 40 headless; doubling instances risks the perf aim for a density change Will can ask for

decision: pnpm visual passes; 3D scenes differ by 195-577 px within the 1024 px tolerance
why: Flag off adds no layer (share 0) and the only flag-off code change is an empty update trigger; diffs are GPU settle noise (uk scene never held still)

decision: Flag sweep scoped to none/trees/all-opt-in: failures are 404s on uncopied optional fauna/food/evidence data
why: Approved data copy omitted those assets; no tree-related console or page error
